text:
Maria Chen: Seeing ~12 failed GPU node boots in eu-west-1 over the last 30m. All show KMS decrypt errors + TLS connect timeouts. Any correlation with recent infra changes?
Tony Li: We tightened provisioning ingress rules earlier this morning. Logs show `AccessDeniedException` for alias swap attempts and `connect ETIMEDOUT` to kms endpoint. snippet: `2026-03-18T02:12:45Z aws-kms: Decrypt failed AccessDeniedException; caused by network error: connect ETIMEDOUT`
infra-bot: autoscaler: 6 node replacements triggered in eu-west-1 in last 15m.
Jamie Patel: We rotated the KMS key for `bootstrap-secrets` at 02:10 UTC (alias swap). Could be a timing/race with nodes booting and trying to decrypt old blob.
Maria Chen: Do we have previous key material or replica alias? Need rollback plan — nodes stuck provisioning and we're seeing fallback reprovision in other regions (cost spike).
Arnold (oncall): @sec @jamie propose: 1) rollback alias to previous key, 2) open tcp/443 from provisioning CIDR (10.4.0.0/21) to `kms.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com` for 30m. Who can submit the fw PR?
sec: On it. Creating a short-lived exception and PR with justification. Planned rule: `allow: 10.4.0.0/21 -> kms.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com:443` (30m). Will add audit note and set expiration.
Tony Li: Noted — also double-check IAM key policy for `kms:Decrypt` on the old key ARN. I saw a `Deny` statement that might have been applied during rotation.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply started: `tf apply -target=module.network.firewall[eu-west-1]`
infra-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply completed in 185s — firewall rule added.
Maria Chen: Rebooting stuck nodes now that fw rule is live. Running `kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep gpu` and `kubectl get pods -n infra -l role=gpu` to watch.
Tony Li: Post-change checks: `aws kms decrypt` success 15/15 for bootstrap key, nodes progressed through init -> kubelet -> joined cluster.
Jamie Patel: We'll schedule a safer KMS rotation playbook: blue/green alias swap + health checks that block alias change if provisioning events in the last 10m. Also saw flow logs gap in the window — audit-bot flagged missing entries.
audit-bot: audit-bot: Detected missing VPC Flow Logs for subnet `subnet-0a1b2c` between 02:05-02:14 UTC. Collector restarted during key rotation. Opened ticket INC-4789 for investigation.
Arnold (oncall): Cost impact: cross-region replacements and on-demand fallbacks added ~USD 800 in the last hour. Please include cost delta in the postmortem.
Maria Chen: Follow-ups: 1) short postmortem, 2) KMS rotation runbook with pre-checks (no active provisioning), 3) terraform guardrail to prevent alias swaps during cluster autoscaler activity. Assigning owners in the ticket. :thumbsup:
Tony Li: Will add a monitoring alert to detect `KMS Decrypt` spike + `ETIMEDOUT` and tie to autoscaler events.
sec: Will keep the short-lived fw exception audit log attached to INC-4789 and revoke after 30m.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — nodes healthy again, closing the operational thread.
